description: Assignment consults the set half, and only that half: writing a throwing setter is reported while reading and destructuring the same member go through the clean getter and pass. With `accessor-read-consults-get` this is the independent-colors pair.

diagnostics.message: Writing `box.value` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it runs the setter `value`, whose body was analyzed and can throw. Your outs: bridge it with `try`/`catch`, or make the setter `value` non-throwing — mark it `@nothrow` and the escapes inside it are reported too.
